findings.message: model limits column "bio" of table "users" to 500 characters, but the database does not enforce it: neither the column type nor a CHECK constraint limits its length
findings.fix: Limit column "bio" of table "users" to 500 characters: keep the maximum length in the model, then regenerate the migration so the column gets a length-limited type or a CHECK on its length, and apply it.
